user.title: Kodara Sync
user.description: This sets up a private sync folder for the Kodara Home app and, if you choose, a view of your devices and pairing codes in Home Assistant. The app encrypts everything it stores here; Home Assistant cannot read it.

address.title: Address for the app
address.description:
Type this address into the Kodara Home app (Data → Sync → Home Assistant). Treat it like a password: whoever has it can read and delete the encrypted files.

`{address}`

abort.single_instance_allowed: Kodara Sync is already set up.
